candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order (/v1/orders) fails with 502; order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) not established.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show every /v1/checkout 502 paired with a client POST /v1/orders 502 to order; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200, low latency). Failure originates downstream at order, but order-side evidence is missing to pin the specific cause.
missing_evidence: Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency outcomes)
Order dependency metrics for postgresql, payment, inventory
